newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westgold buys 4.99 pct more Bolnisi.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westgold buys 4.99 pct more Bolnisi.

text.p: Westgold Resources NL said on Monday it had entered an agreement to acquire another 6.67 million shares in Bolnisi Gold NL, representing 4.9 percent of Bolnisi's capital, at 16 cents each.
This was on top of the 20.12 million Bolnisi shares that Westgold said earlier on Monday it had acquired on Friday for the same price.
Westgold said it was now entitled to 26.79 million Bolnisi shares or 19.97 percent of its issued capital.
Westgold, which is involved in a merger with Ramsgate Resources NL, said after its first announcement that it had made no decision to make a takeover bid for Bolnisi.
Shares in Bolnisi, which is involved in gold mining in the former Soviet republic of Georgia, rose 1.5 cents to close at 17.5 cents on Monday after touching a new year high of 18 cents.
